svg.text: C4 Level 2: ESPACIO Container Diagram & QA/PROD Edge/HA Topology (v2.0)
Full deployment view: Cloudflare WAF -> AWS ALB -> Spring Cloud API Gateway -> Multi-AZ HA Replicas -> 4 Polyglot DBs + PaaS + Observability

g.text: 1. Edge Layer — Cloudflare Global Network (QA: qa.espacio.app | PROD: espacio.app, api.espacio.app)
React MFE Shell + Wasm | Astro QR | Next.js Opt
Cloudflare DNS + SSL/TLS Full (Strict) + Managed WAF
DDoS Shield • OWASP SQLi/XSS Rules • Edge Rate Limiting • Static Asset CDN
Origin IP hidden; only Cloudflare IPs whitelisted on AWS Security Groups
Site24x7 External Monitors + Sentry.io Telemetry Ingest
Sentry.io receives FE/BE exceptions, spans & source maps tagged env=qa|prod
2. AWS Cloud VPC (Replicated Topology for QA & PROD Environments — Multi-AZ High Availability)
Load Balancer — AWS ALB / Nginx Reverse Proxy (HA)
• Distributes HTTPS/WSS across AZ-a and AZ-b targets
• Zero-downtime rolling deploys & automatic unhealthy failover
API Gateway — Spring Cloud Gateway (2+ Replicas HA)
• Strict CORS allow-list, Redis-backed Rate Limiting & Security Headers
• Astro 5 Public Street-QR (/p/:code) fed by PaaS CMS
High Availability Application Tier (Auto-Scaling / ECS — Min 2 Replicas)
Availability Zone A — Spring Boot 3 Backend Replica #1
• REST + Stripe HMAC Webhook + STOMP WS + GraphQL + MCP
• Spring AI RAG Orchestrator + Outbox Relay (SKIP LOCKED)
• Sentry Java SDK + Structured JSON ODD Logs
Availability Zone B — Spring Boot 3 Backend Replica #2
• Automatic Failover via AWS ALB if AZ-a fails healthcheck
• Shared concurrency safety via Redis Locks & MySQL SKIP LOCKED
• Independent horizontal scale-out under k6 / PROD load
n8n Automation Worker: Emails, Reminders, Cascade Refunds
AWS S3 Bucket: 2D ReferenceSketches & Immutable PDF Invoices
AWS Secrets Manager: Stripe keys, DB creds, Sentry DSN (0 hardcoded)
PaaS Connector: Strapi / Contentful / Supabase (CMS & Auth/Storage)
3. Polyglot Persistence Tier — 4 Specialized Databases (Private Subnets — Zero Public Access)
Property specs, trade rules & escrow FAQs
4. QA vs. PROD Environment Topology & Promotion Gate (Practical Requirements #1–#26 + Opt #1)
QA Environment (qa.espacio.app | Branch: qa | DockerHub: qa-latest)
• Cloudflare Proxy + SSL Strict + QA WAF rules + Site24x7 1-min uptime monitor
• AWS ALB + Spring Cloud Gateway + 2x Spring Boot Replicas (HA failover verified via k6)
• All 4 DBs live (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Qdrant) + Keycloak QA realm + Stripe Test Mode
• PaaS CMS (Strapi/Contentful QA workspace) + n8n QA workflows + Sentry project: espacio-qa
• Mandatory CI/CD Gate: Unit + Functional (Testcontainers) + E2E (Playwright) + Load (k6)
PROD Environment (espacio.app | Branch: main | DockerHub: prod-vX.Y.Z)
• Cloudflare Proxy + SSL Strict + Strict OWASP WAF + Bot Protection + Site24x7 30s alerts
• AWS Multi-AZ ALB + 2x API Gateway + Auto-Scaling Spring Boot Replicas (Zero-Downtime HA)
• Multi-AZ MySQL Primary/Standby + MongoDB Replica Set + Redis Failover + Qdrant Snapshots
• PaaS CMS PROD + n8n PROD + Sentry project: espacio-prod (P1 alerts to Slack/Email)
• Promoted ONLY from verified QA release with Dual Approval Gate (Architect + QA/Tech Lead)
